svg.title: Maknae agent task lifecycle
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram of an agent task, each step marked live, unreachable, decided or planned: binding recognition, the sealed tasker token, intake and the reach observation in the Egress Daemon, forge_auth on the agent's notice poll for a stored-token agent, the queue, the agent's claim poll, the hand-out, the agentic loop with the tool-call sequence, the credential's storage and re-mint, the heartbeat and the optional add, ask, approval and stop exchanges, then the report, the revoke and the collect.
svg.text: An agent's task: bindings and reach, the pull hand-off, the agentic loop, the outcome and the revoke
maknaed never dials an agent: maknae-agentd polls until a task is queued for it, then works it in the agentic loop. Each tool call is the one a person makes (generated-tool-invocation.svg).
An agent whose forge credential is a stored token is asked for it through forge_auth on its notice poll (#746) before its task is claimable.

Inside the loop, the tasker may add to the task, the agent may ask (#736), a tool call may wait for the tasker's approval (#174), and the tasker may stop it; halting its containers is #481. Each step shows its build state.
[the agent's credential is a GitHub App]
«decided» [the agent's credential is a stored token]
[until a task is queued for this agent]
1. «live» bind from prompt links and checkout remotes; echo what was not bound
whose forge observes reach; seal the
4. «live» intake: decide session.task, re-validate and seal the bindings
the sealed tasker token, a deadline
11. «live» seal reach (tasker ∩ agent), sign the task, record it, queue it
12. «live» echo what was bound and its
13. «decided» queue forge_auth for the agent: the task and its forge servers
stored token per named server; seal
sealed token, the tasker side sealed
22. «decided» decide on the reach; sign the task with it, once; queue it
28. «#168» store each minted set's for_revocation blob with the task
re-checking the agent side of reach
44. «#481» stop watch and cancel token halt the task's tool containers within N seconds
«live» built, reachable in production · «unreachable» built, no production caller · «decided» in an ADR, not built · «#N» planned in that issue
GitHub forge token in Vault at <kv_mount>/data/<user_prefix>/<you>/forges/<host>, field token: vault write -wrap-ttl=60s, or maknae forge login <host>. docs/first-provider.md U2.
Only hosts of git forges in the subject's catalog bind. A task carries at most 8 bindings; a binding never changes after sealing.
A binding's server must be a current git forge host; a sub-task's binding must equal one of its parent's.
The kernel carries the tasker's token sealed and never opens it. Sub-tasks take the tasker side from the parent's reach.
Every answer but 200 refuses the task, a 404 included. The tasker's token is used for this read only and never stored.
GET /repos is never called with an installation token: its permissions block reads all false (measured 2026-11-19).
Ruled 2026-11-26, not built: egress returns each observation with a copy sealed to itself, and computes the intersection (ADR-0037 decision 7).

Queued in the task store; nothing is sent to the agent. GitLab tools stay refused in tasks. Ruled 2026-11-26, not built: a stored-token agent's task is stored AwaitingReach here, signed once its reach is decided.
Ruled 2026-11-26, not built: for a stored-token agent it says "awaiting the agent's reach"; the effective reach shows in status and list once decided.
For an own-initiative task whose submitter holds a stored token, the submitter is asked too, for the tasker side. No credential is carried.
Control frames only. It never renews the claim lease; the heartbeat still does, so a wedged loop lapses.
The agent's own token is stored in Vault beforehand (ADR-0038 decision 2).
Refused, forwarding nothing, unless the task is AwaitingReach for this agent.
The kernel opens neither. The sealed side binds the task id and its bindings, so it cannot be altered or swapped.
404, or 403 without rate-limit headers: empty, AgentNotCovered. 401, 429, a rate-limited 403, 5xx or the deadline: the task closes NotReached.
A task is never claimable before its reach is decided.
Hand-out re-decides the tasker's role and the agent's taskers:, not the tasker's provider reach (ADR-0037 residual 1). Claimable only once reach is decided.
Live for the file tools and sub-tasks. A gh, git or cargo call in a tool container is #479; its mint and launch are the tool-call diagram's steps.
Produced by the mint in the tool-call diagram (steps 11 to 13). The task store has no field for it yet. A rotation of egress's seal key strands every outstanding blob (ADR-0038 residual 2).
Ruled 2026-11-26: at each launch, when the remaining life is under the call's timeout plus launch time; the old token is revoked at once.
Sent after a step once HEARTBEAT_EVERY has passed; it renews the 15-minute claim lease. A stop or follow-up is seen here.

Refused once the task is Reported. An /add with new bindings repeats steps 5 to 10, and 13 to 22 for a stored-token agent, and is a signed addendum; a stored-token add is held with its follow-up until its reach is decided. The agent gets it on its next heartbeat.
At the agent's discretion; this is not an interactive session. The question's shape is open in #736.
The tasker may narrow what the site allows, never widen it. Matching and expiry of an approval are open in #174.
The agent never reaches the tasker; the request waits in maknaed until the tasker's session reads it.
The decision never passes through the agent; the kernel still checks it against the site's authorization.
Cooperative today: the agent sees the stop at its next heartbeat, after its in-flight step.
Ruled 2026-11-26: conditions 1 to 5 end by construction; 6, a compromised agent, is cut off by the revoke (step 46).
Ruled 2026-11-26: every close and move to Held, best effort; the kernel caller is wired with #168 PR C. Each gets a trail intent and outcome (ADR-0038 decision 10).
No kernel caller sends this until step 46 is built; an ADR-0038 as-built line follows then. The reach driver's metadata-read token is already revoked live (step 9).
Nothing is pushed: the open session pulls. On opening a session, it first shows what came while you were away.
